title: Imperial Bedroom
notes:
Issued in a standard sleeve with the Warner 'W' logo embossed towards the top, right-hand corner of the back cover. 
Includes a heavy stock card inner sleeve with lyrics on both sides (a die-cut centre hole reveals a matching design on the Side B label only). Initial copies also came with a postcard depicting the album cover.

Imperial Bedroom is styled as IbMePdErRoIoAmL on the front cover, spine and Side A label.

[Back cover:]
Recorded at Air Recording Studios, London

[Inner sleeve, both sides:]
© Plangent Visions Music Limited

[Side A label:]
All titles ... published by Plangent Visions Music Ltd. except 
* [Track B5] ... published by Plangent Visions Music Ltd. / Rondor Music (London) Ltd.
℗ 1982 Riviera Global Record Productions Ltd.
© 1982 F-Beat Records Ltd.
A Warner Communications Company [Warner 'W' logo]
